route_note: fast_gemv.cu plus its two sibling headers fast_gemv.cuh and utility.cuh from fbgemm_gpu/experimental/gen_ai/src/quantize/fast_gemv/include/ (buggy 8b87d01bfe / fix 2c32f22baf) copied byte-for-byte (harness/r2_extract.sh; fixdiff.py RESULT PASS over 3 files, targets/lit-fbgemm-1/r2/fixdiff.check; the fix touches only fast_gemv.cu). No torch dependency (the torch wrapper bf16_fast_gemv.cu is not needed). common/driver.cu #includes the verbatim fast_gemv.cu and launches gemv_bf16 the way the wrapper does. The only external dependency is header-only CUTLASS: the exact commit FBGEMM pins as submodule external/cutlass at the buggy commit, 571edeb2d0ac872a8392fc49285b156b07884b4e (jwfromm/cutlass branch FBGEMM, merge of PR #4, 2025-12-12; include/cutlass/version.h = 4.3.0; not an upstream tag, `git describe` finds none), fetched on the login node with `git fetch --depth 1 origin <sha>` from https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass.git (GitHub serves the fork-network commit) into ~/incoming/realworld/deps/cutlass (git dir, 32 MB) and packed as ~/incoming/realworld/deps/cutlass-include-571edeb.tar.gz (`git archive FETCH_HEAD include`, 803 files, 2.2 MB); t_build unpacks it node-locally into $OUT/cutlass and uses -I$OUT/cutlass/include. nvcc flags: -std=c++20 -O3 -DNDEBUG --expt-relaxed-constexpr --expt-extended-lambda -DCUTLASS_ENABLE_TENSOR_CORE_MMA=1 -DCUTLASS_DEBUG_TRACE_LEVEL=0 plus $RW_NVCC_FLAGS (-arch=sm_89) and -lineinfo; never -G. (FBGEMM's own CMake nvcc flag list for gen_ai could not be located quickly in the partial clone; these are standard release flags, identical for both variants.)
driver: common/driver.cu: gemv_bf16<<<dim3(1, n/block.y)=(1,64), block=(256,1)>>>(mat bf16[n*k], vec bf16[m*k], res bf16[m*n], k, m, n, num_per_thread = k/block.x = 8); args m n k default 2 64 2048; host reference check prints mismatches (small-integer inputs, exact).
input: m=2 vector rows, n=64 matrix rows (64 blocks of 256 threads = 8 warps), k=2048, bf16 small integers. Thread-level access estimate: per thread 1 LDG.128 mat + m=2 LDG.128 vec = 3 global loads x 256 threads x 64 blocks = 4.9e4; shared per block per col 8 STS + 8 LDS (x2 cols) = 32 x 64 blocks = 2e3; plus 128 STG results: about 5.2e4 in total, far below 1e7.
notes: Smoke on c38 (sm_75, debugging only, never a result): both variants rc=0, printed 'gemv_bf16 m=2 n=64 k=2048 grid=(1,64) block=(256,1) num_per_thread=8 mismatches=0/128' (the race did not manifest; detection is by happens-before). The col loop is unrolled into three code copies in the SASS; the buggy build has no barrier between a copy's LDS (L145) and the next copy's STS (L141), the fixed build has predicated BAR.SYNC attributed to L154 there (see oracle sass_notes). The fatbin also holds gemv_quantized_int4 and gemv_quantized_bf16_fp8 (non-template kernels in the same file; the second has the same racy loop and the same fix, never launched by the driver; T_KERNEL=gemv_bf16 does not match their names). Compile time ~8 s per variant.
